faqs.question: What are your hours of operation?
faqs.answer: We operate Monday through Friday from 9:00 AM to 6:00 PM IST.

faqs.question: How do I submit my internship project?
faqs.answer: You can submit your public GitHub repository link through your Student Workspace.

faqs.question: When will I receive my certificate?
faqs.answer: Certificates are reviewed and issued within 3-5 business days after your code review.
